name: Remote Backup
author: Bo Reese (bobreese)
description: Designate this FPP as a Backup Host and pull rsync backups of one or more MultiSync remotes onto local NVMe/SSD, USB, or SD card storage. Configurable concurrent transfers (up to 8), --dry-run space checks, mirrored deletes, and dated/rolling per-remote backups named like Pi5-20260803.
